journal.title: Journal
journal.emptyHint: Entries appear here once you record the first one.
journal.noMatchHint: The filters hide every entry. Widen the date range or clear them.
journal.noWorkspaceHint: The journal belongs to a workspace. Create one first.

fx.note: Foreign currency: {amount} at rate {rate} is {base} in the books.
fx.mixed: This entry carries more than one currency or rate. Shown: {amount} at rate {rate}, {base} in the books. Check the lines one by one.

entry.periodLockedWayOut: To post this entry, change the booking date to {date}, the nearest open period. Your entered lines are kept.
entry.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to post.
entry.noAccountMatch: No account matches what you typed.
entry.reverseConfirmBody: A correction is always an additional entry: TILL posts a reversal with debit and credit swapped. The original entry stays in the journal unchanged, both entries remain visible, and the two cancel each other out.
entry.deleteConfirmBody: The draft and its lines are removed for good. A draft has never been posted, so nothing in the books changes, but the draft itself cannot be recovered.
entry.discardConfirmBody: What you entered in this entry is not saved yet and will be lost.
entry.vatUnreconciled: The VAT does not reconcile: the tagged lines add up to {expected}, but the VAT accounts book {booked}.

errors.unbalanced: The entry does not balance. Debits must equal credits.
errors.period_locked: The period is locked, so nothing was posted.
errors.not_a_draft: That entry is posted and cannot be deleted, only reversed.
errors.already_reversed: That entry has already been reversed.
errors.not_posted: Only a posted entry can be reversed.
errors.not_found: That entry could not be found.
errors.invalid_line: A line is invalid. Each line needs an account and exactly one amount.
errors.invalid_source: That posting source is not allowed here.
errors.vat_trace_unreconciled: The VAT on this entry does not reconcile with the VAT accounts, so nothing was posted.
errors.unknown_tax_code: A line uses a tax code that does not exist in this workspace.
errors.archived_tax_code: A line uses an archived tax code, so nothing was posted. Choose an active code.
errors.needs_vat_config: VAT is not set up for this workspace yet.

Journal.title: Journal
Journal.body:
The journal is the immutable list of every entry posted in TILL for this workspace. Posted entries are never rewritten: a correction is always a reversing entry that cancels the mistake visibly.

Every line carries its account, its amount and, where VAT is involved, its tax code. The return is later computed from that code.

A taken-over prior-system journal appears beside it as its own archive. It is not part of the live chain of records.
